name: ChatWidget
description: Collapsible AI assistant with first-interaction transparency, session-only history and streaming replies.

endpoint.description:
Optional override for the API endpoint.
Defaults to VITE_DONNY_CHAT_ENDPOINT, otherwise falls back to the secure proxy or /api/chat.

criteria.statement: Required stories produce no axe violations at the configured severity.
The accessibility tree (role, name, state) matches the committed snapshot for every required story.
The component remains legible and operable under a real browser forced-colors: active pass.
Every documented keyboard interaction works as specified.
criteria.note: No exportable evidence record for this check; re-run the check to capture one.

criteria.statement: Documented ARIA roles, states, and properties are present on the rendered output.
criteria.note: No exportable evidence record for this check; re-run the check to capture one.

criteria.statement: A human completed an end-to-end accessibility review of this component.
criteria.note: 2026-07-14 — streaming display reviewed: only the active assistant reply uses grapheme-safe adaptive smoothing; reduced motion bypasses it and the polite message log remains aria-busy until the complete response is available.

transitions.statement: A request with no first token after the acknowledge-delay threshold shows a polite status saying it is taking longer than usual, next to the Stop control; the notice clears as soon as the reply starts or the request ends.

validity.statement: After New chat clears the conversation, the previous transcript can be restored with Undo for the undo-window threshold; sending a new message or the window ending makes the clear final.

interruptions.statement: The transcript is kept in sessionStorage and restored when the widget mounts again in the same tab, including after a reload, so leaving and returning does not lose the conversation. Nothing is written to storage until the restore has run, so the first render cannot overwrite it.

When a request fails before reaching a server (failed to fetch or 404), the widget switches to the alternate endpoint and resends the last message once; a request that reached a server is never resent automatically.
If sending the email fails, the draft is kept so the person can edit or retry without retyping.

actions.statement: New chat empties the conversation and offers Undo for ten seconds.
Donny sends an email to the studio only from the review step, which lists every field that will be sent; a repeated Send while sending does nothing.
